    • FAQs

      Questions you may have, answered with
      • How does display quality vary in Helios 300 models?
        Display options in the Helios 300 range can vary, typically offering Full HD or QHD resolutions. Look for higher refresh rates like 144Hz or 240Hz for smoother gameplay. Some models may also feature IPS technology for better viewing angles and color accuracy.
        How'd we do?
      • What cooling technology is used in Helios 300?
        The Helios 300 uses Acer's AeroBlade 3D fan technology. This feature enhances cooling efficiency, which is crucial for maintaining performance during extended gaming sessions. Effective cooling helps prevent thermal throttling and extends the laptop's longevity.
        How'd we do?
      • Are there customizable lighting features?
        Yes, the Helios 300 often includes RGB-backlit keyboards with customizable lighting zones. This feature allows users to personalize their setup and can also enhance gaming experience by setting different profiles for various games.
